comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
"Duke of Viseu's Treasure Sword"

"A replica of the sword used by the first Duke of Viseu."

Obtained for completing the "Looking to Hire" quest, one of the next to last quests for completing the Prince Henrique storyline. Stats:

Swordplay +2
Sword Mastery +2
Leadership +2

Requires 5k fame to equip. It's not the best, but a pretty nice starter sword if you can get through the whole story.
